```{r}
pacman::p_load(
    BiocGenerics, 
    IRanges,
    GenomicRanges,
    GenomeInfoDb # harmonize different naming for chromosomes
    )
########

#-Genomic Ranges
########

### IRanges
ir <- IRanges(start = 1:3, width = 5)
df_ir_c <- data.frame(ir=ir)
df_ir_c

# DataFrame - more versatile
df_ir <- DataFrame(ir=ir, score = rnorm(3))
df_ir[1,1]
df_ir

### GRanges
gr <- GRanges(seqnames= "chr1", strand = c('+', '-', '+'),
              ranges = IRanges(start = c(1,3,5), width = 3))
gr
values(gr) = DataFrame(score = rnorm(3))
values(gr)
gr$score

# ---
gr2 <- GRanges(seqnames= c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3"), strand = c("*"),
              ranges = IRanges(start = c(1,3,5), width = 3))
gr2
# ---
findOverlaps(gr, gr2)
subsetByOverlaps(gr, gr2) # Genomic Range with elements that overlaps

# --- Subset a chromosome
gr <- GRanges(seqnames = c("chr1", "chr2"),
              ranges = IRanges(start = 1:2, end = 4:5))

dropSeqlevels(gr, "chr2", pruning.mode="tidy")
```
